en-US.description: A local UI customization tool for the Codex desktop client
en-US.longDescription:
Codex Tweaks is a local customization tool for the Codex desktop client. Through unified, simple feature-package management, it lets you adjust the UI, extend interface interactions, and personalize the appearance without modifying Codex application files.
Codex Tweaks is an unofficial local customization tool and is not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI. After a Codex update, some feature packages may need to be adapted.

Main features
- Change the Codex interface style and visuals to personalize the appearance to your preference
- Adjust page layout, interface components, and interaction patterns so common content and actions are handier
- Add new interface elements, status hints, or accessibility features that extend the original Codex experience
- Combine multiple feature packages as needed and manage different UI modifications and visual effects in one place
- Enable, disable, or update individual feature packages at any time, or turn off all interface enhancements and restore the original interface with one click
- Install feature packages from a local directory, ZIP, or Git repository, with the app handling wiring, dependencies, compilation, load order, and failure fallback
- Export installed feature packages as reinstallable ZIP archives for backup or sharing
- Follow the system preferred language automatically, with manual switching between Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, and Korean
- On macOS, hide the Dock, app-switcher, and menu-bar icons separately while background injection keeps running
Codex Tweaks does not modify Codex application files. After interface enhancements are disabled, styles, components, and event listeners added to pages are cleaned up, and Codex keeps working as before.

Security Notice
- Feature packs run within Codex pages and may access page content. Only install feature packs and their dependencies that you trust and are willing to run
- Git feature packs are locked to specific versions; updates and compilation must be manually triggered by the user
- Dependency lifecycle scripts are suppressed before authorization. For feature packs that request Node access, explicitly authorizing the current version may run npm lifecycle scripts during locked dependency installation; feature packs themselves remain third-party code
- Codex Tweaks only applies enhancements to the local Codex interface and does not inject into regular web pages
- Local connections only listen on localhost; do not expose them to external networks via proxies or port forwarding

zh-CN.description: 面向 Codex 桌面客户端的本地界面定制工具
zh-CN.longDescription:
Codex Tweaks 是一个面向 Codex 桌面客户端的本地界面定制工具。它通过统一、简单的功能包管理方式，让用户无需直接修改 Codex 应用文件，也能调整 UI、扩展界面交互并进行个性化美化。
Codex Tweaks 是非官方的本地定制工具，与 OpenAI 没有隶属或授权关系。Codex 更新后，部分功能包可能需要同步适配。

主要功能
- 改变 Codex 的界面样式和视觉表现，根据自己的偏好进行个性化美化
- 调整页面布局、界面组件和交互方式，让常用内容和操作更顺手
- 添加新的界面元素、状态提示或辅助功能，扩展 Codex 原有的使用体验
- 按需组合多个功能包，集中管理不同的 UI 修改和美化效果
- 随时启用、停用或更新单个功能包，也可以一键关闭全部界面增强并恢复原始界面
- 从本地目录、ZIP 或 Git 仓库安装功能包，由应用统一处理连接、依赖、编译、加载顺序和失败回退
- 将已安装的功能包导出为可再次安装的 ZIP，便于备份或分享源码
- 自动跟随系统首选语言，并支持在简体中文、繁体中文、英语、日语和韩语之间手动切换
- macOS 可分别隐藏 Dock、应用切换器和菜单栏图标，同时保持后台注入
Codex Tweaks 不会修改 Codex 的应用文件。停用界面增强后，已加入页面的样式、组件和事件监听会被清理，Codex 本身可以继续使用。

安全说明
- 功能包会在 Codex 页面中运行，可能接触页面内容。只安装自己信任并愿意运行的功能包及其依赖
- Git 功能包会锁定到明确版本；更新和编译需要由用户主动触发
- 授权前的依赖构建会禁止安装脚本。对于请求 Node 权限的功能包，用户明确授权当前版本后，锁定的依赖安装可能执行 npm 生命周期脚本；功能包本身仍属于第三方代码
- Codex Tweaks 只向 Codex 的本地界面应用增强，不向普通网页注入
- 本地连接只监听本机；不要通过代理或端口转发将它暴露到外部网络
